subject: general
question: President Murmu honours __________ nurses with National Florence Nightingale Awards 2025.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**15**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• President Murmu honours 15 nurses with National Florence Nightingale Awards 2025.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**President Droupadi Murmu** presented the **2025 Florence Nightingale Awards**.

 
 
• 
 
A total of **15 nursing professionals** were honored.

 
 
• 
 
Award recognizes **outstanding contribution in nursing**.

 
 
• 
 
Instituted in **1973** by the **Ministry of Health and Family Welfare**.

 
 
• 
 
Held at **Rashtrapati Bhavan**.
